examples.scenario: A 1 m DTM parcel under dense vegetation is assumed to have at least one ground point per square metre because the DSM specification says 1 ppsqm
examples.reason: EA states the density figure is for DSM and DTM ground-return density under vegetation can be lower.

examples.scenario: A point-cloud minimum is reported as the final DTM minimum without checking manual terrain-model editing
examples.reason: EA notes classified ground points do not necessarily match the final manually edited DTM.

examples.scenario: A timestamped DSM is used for ground height because it has the desired survey date and resolution
examples.reason: DSM contains surface objects; target ground-height work requires DTM semantics.

examples.scenario: The newest National LIDAR Programme phase is selected without intersecting the target parcel with coverage metadata
examples.reason: Repeat phases are spatially selective; source selection must be bound to target coverage.

examples.scenario: A 2012 survey transformed with an older model is silently mixed with OSTN15/OSGM15 data
examples.reason: OS documents the transition from OSTN02/OSGM02 to OSTN15/OSGM15; model provenance must be explicit.

examples.scenario: A Liverpool-datum height is converted to Newlyn with one fixed national offset
examples.reason: OS states datum differences vary spatially and can vary between kilometre squares.

examples.scenario: Centimetre-scale corrected GNSS capability is used as the claimed accuracy of the LIDAR raster
examples.reason: Checkpoint positioning, transformation and LIDAR vertical error are different uncertainty components.

examples.scenario: The same ±15 cm survey threshold is assigned independently to min and max and combined as sqrt(2) without covariance analysis
examples.reason: Shared survey, datum and processing errors may be correlated between extrema.

examples.scenario: A first-return DSM peak is used as the terrain maximum for a parcel containing trees
examples.reason: First-return DSM includes vegetation and surface objects and is not ground terrain.

examples.scenario: The target tile has no matching archived point cloud but has a valid timestamped DTM and survey metadata
examples.reason: EA notes historic archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every surface model; absence must be disclosed rather than invented.
